               'as.character.nrv2label', 'as.list.nrv2visible', 'unlist.nrv2visible',
               'is.numeric.nrv2dim', 'c.nrv2dim', 'Summary.nrv2dim', 'Summary.nrv2size')
  on.exit(rm(list = methods, envir = globalenv()))
  capture <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = conditionMessage)
  shape <- list(structure(1:4, class = 'nrv2shape'), structure(5:8, class = 'nrv2shape'))
  named_shape <- setNames(shape, c('A', 'B'))
  scalar_shape <- list(A = structure(1L, class = 'nrv2shape'),
                       B = structure(2L, class = 'nrv2shape'))
  d <- c(2L, 2L)
  dn <- NULL
  dim.nrv2shape <<- function(x) d
  dimnames.nrv2shape <<- function(x) dn
  dimensions <- lapply(list(integer = c(2L, 2L), double = c(2, 2),
                           character = c('2', '2'), logical = c(TRUE, TRUE),
                           list = list(2L, 2L), complex = c(2 + 0i, 2 + 0i),
                           fraction = c(2.5, 1.6), missing = c(NA_real_, 2),
                           attributed = structure(c(2L, 2L), tag = 9L)),
                       function(value) { d <<- value; capture(simplify2array(shape)) })
  scalar_dimensions <- lapply(list(empty_integer = integer(), empty_double = numeric(),
                                  empty_logical = logical(), null = NULL, zero = 0L,
                                  negative = c(-1L, -1L), fraction = c(1.5, 2 / 3)),
                              function(value) {
                                d <<- value
                                capture(simplify2array(scalar_shape, except = NULL))
                              })
  dimension_classes <- lapply(list(factor = factor(c('b', 'b'), levels = c('a', 'b')),
                                  Date = structure(c(2L, 2L), class = 'Date'),
                                  POSIXt = structure(c(2L, 2L), class = 'POSIXt'),
                                  difftime = structure(c(2L, 2L), class = 'difftime')),
                              function(value) {d <<- value; capture(simplify2array(shape))})
  numeric_events <- character()
  d <- structure(c(2L, 2L), class = 'nrv2dim')
  is.numeric.nrv2dim <<- function(x) {numeric_events <<- c(numeric_events, 'numeric'); FALSE}
  numeric_declined <- simplify2array(shape, higher = NA)
  declined_events <- numeric_events
  numeric_events <- character()
  is.numeric.nrv2dim <<- function(x) {numeric_events <<- c(numeric_events, 'numeric'); TRUE}
  Summary.nrv2dim <<- function(..., na.rm = FALSE) stop('dimension class must be dropped')
  numeric_ordinary <- simplify2array(shape)
  ordinary_events <- numeric_events
  numeric_events <- character()
  c.nrv2dim <<- function(..., recursive = FALSE) {
    numeric_events <<- c(numeric_events, 'combine')
    structure(c(2L, 2L, 2L), class = 'nrv2size')
  }
  Summary.nrv2size <<- function(..., na.rm = FALSE) {
    numeric_events <<- c(numeric_events, paste(.Generic, .Group, na.rm, sep = ':'))
    7
  }
  numeric_rejected <- simplify2array(shape)
  product_events <- numeric_events
  unknown_higher_false <- simplify2array(shape, higher = NA)
  Summary.nrv2size <<- function(..., na.rm = FALSE) stop('product rejected')
  product_error <- capture(simplify2array(shape))
  unknown_higher_error <- capture(simplify2array(shape, higher = NA))
  numeric_events <- character()
  is.numeric.nrv2dim <<- function(x) {numeric_events <<- c(numeric_events, 'numeric'); NA}
  numeric_unknown <- capture(simplify2array(shape))
  numeric_gates <- list(classes = dimension_classes, declined = numeric_declined,
                        declined_events = declined_events, ordinary = numeric_ordinary,
                        ordinary_events = ordinary_events, rejected = numeric_rejected,
                        product_events = product_events, product_error = product_error,
                        unknown = numeric_unknown, unknown_events = numeric_events,
                        unknown_higher_false = unknown_higher_false, unknown_higher_error = unknown_higher_error)
  events <- character()
  as.character.nrv2label <<- function(x, ...) {
    events <<- c(events, 'as.character.nrv2label')
    stop('axis method must remain unused')
  }
  axis <- NULL
  names.nrv2axis <<- function(x) axis
  axis_input <- list(A = structure(1:4, class = 'nrv2axis'),
                     B = structure(5:8, class = 'nrv2axis'))
  axes <- lapply(list(character = structure(c('a', 'b', 'c', 'd'),
                                           class = 'nrv2label', tag = 3L,
                                           names = c('first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth')),
                     atomic = structure(1:4, class = 'nrv2label', tag = 3L),
                     list = structure(list('a', 'b', 'c', 'd'), class = 'nrv2label', tag = 3L),
                     factor = factor(c('b', 'a', 'd', 'c')),
                     expression = expression(a, b, c, d),
                     pairlist = pairlist('a', 'b', 'c', 'd'),
                     wrong_length = c('a', 'b')),
                 function(value) {
                   axis <<- value
                   capture(simplify2array(axis_input, higher = FALSE))
                 })
  d <- c(2L, 2L)
  packing <- lapply(list(empty = list(), one = list(c('r1', 'r2')),
                        one_named = list(rows = c('r1', 'r2')),
                        full = list(rows = c('r1', 'r2'), cols = c('c1', 'c2')),
                        missing_label = setNames(list(c('r1', 'r2')), NA_character_),
                        pairlist = pairlist(rows = c('r1', 'r2')),
                        empty_character = character(), empty_integer = integer(),
                        classed = structure(list(c('r1', 'r2'), c('c1', 'c2')),
                                            class = 'container', tag = 5L,
                                            names = c('rows', 'cols')),
                        expression = expression(c('r1', 'r2'), c('c1', 'c2')),
                        too_long = list(c('r1', 'r2'), c('c1', 'c2'), 1:2)),
                    function(value) {
                      dn <<- value
                      capture(simplify2array(named_shape))
                    })
  d <- c(1L, 1L)
  atomic_packing <- lapply(list(character = c('row', 'column'),
                               named_character = c(rows = 'row', cols = 'column'),
                               numeric = 1:2, named_numeric = c(rows = 1L, cols = 2L),
                               pairlist = pairlist(rows = 'row', cols = 'column')),
                           function(value) {
                             dn <<- value
                             capture(simplify2array(scalar_shape, except = NULL))
                           })
  as.list.nrv2visible <<- function(x, ...) invisible(list(1L, 2L))
  unlist.nrv2visible <<- function(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = TRUE) invisible(1:2)
  visibility <- list(sapply_false = withVisible(sapply(structure(1:2, class = 'nrv2visible'),
                                                       identity, simplify = FALSE)),
                     empty = withVisible(simplify2array(invisible(list()), higher = stop('unused'))),
                     scalar = withVisible(simplify2array(structure(list(1L, 2L), class = 'nrv2visible'))))
  list(dimensions = dimensions, scalar_dimensions = scalar_dimensions, numeric_gates = numeric_gates,
       axes = axes, packing = packing, atomic_packing = atomic_packing,
       visibility = visibility, axis_method_events = events)
})

{
  f<-function(i)matrix(1:4+i,2)
  shapes<-list(ordinary=mapply(f,1:2),higher=mapply(f,1:2,SIMPLIFY='array'),
    listScalar=mapply(function(i)list(k=i),1:2),nestedScalar=mapply(function(i)list(list(k=i)),1:2),
    listMatrix=mapply(function(i)list(first=structure(i,tag='cell'),second=quote(z)),1:2),
    factorScalar=mapply(function(z)ordered(z,levels=c('x','y')),c('x','y')),
    factorMatrix=mapply(function(i)factor(c('x','y')),1:2),zero=mapply(function(i)integer(),1:2))
  seen<-character();mark<-function(name,value){seen<<-c(seen,name);value}
  fun<-function(x,y,z=0){seen<<-c(seen,paste0('call',x));x+y+z}
  forcingValue<-mapply(mark('FUN',fun),mark('X',1:2),mark('Y',3:4),MoreArgs=mark('MORE',list(z=10)),USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',TRUE))
  forcingTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  emptyValue<-mapply(mark('FUN',fun),mark('X',integer()),mark('Y',3:4),MoreArgs=mark('MORE',NULL),USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',FALSE))
  emptyTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  noInputs<-mapply(mark('FUN',identity),MoreArgs=mark('MORE',NULL),USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',TRUE))
  noInputTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  recycled<-mapply(function(x,y){seen<<-c(seen,paste0('call',x));x+y},1:3,1:2,USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',TRUE))
  recycleTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  caught<-tryCatch(mapply(function(x,y){seen<<-c(seen,paste0('call',x));x+y},1:3,1:2,USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',TRUE)),warning=function(w){seen<<-c(seen,'warning');conditionMessage(w)})
  caughtTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  failed<-tryCatch(mapply(function(x,y){seen<<-c(seen,paste0('call',x));if(x==2)stop('callback');x+y},1:3,1:2,USE.NAMES=mark('NAMES',TRUE),SIMPLIFY=mark('SIMPLIFY',TRUE)),error=conditionMessage)
  failedTrace<-seen
  seen<-character()
  as.list.mapplyFixture<<-function(...)stop('unused conversion')
  length.mapplyFixture<<-function(x){seen<<-c(seen,'length');2L}
  `[[.mapplyFixture`<<-function(x,i,...){seen<<-c(seen,paste0('extract',i));i+10L}
  names.mapplyFixture<<-function(x){seen<<-c(seen,'names');c('u','v')}
  x<-structure(1:2,class='mapplyFixture')
  classed<-mapply(identity,x);classTrace<-seen
  seen<-character();unused<-mapply(function(z)42,x);unusedTrace<-seen
  localMethods<-local({length.mapplyFixture<-function(x)stop('local length');`[[.mapplyFixture`<-function(x,i,...)stop('local extraction');names.mapplyFixture<-function(x)stop('local names');mapply(identity,x)})
  mapped<-Map(identity,x)
  rm(list=c('as.list.mapplyFixture','length.mapplyFixture','[[.mapplyFixture','names.mapplyFixture'),envir=globalenv())
  list(shapes=shapes,forcing=list(value=forcingValue,trace=forcingTrace),empty=list(value=emptyValue,trace=emptyTrace),
    noInputs=list(value=noInputs,trace=noInputTrace),recycled=list(value=recycled,trace=recycleTrace),
    caught=list(value=caught,trace=caughtTrace),failed=list(value=failed,trace=failedTrace),
    classed=list(value=classed,trace=classTrace,unused=unused,unusedTrace=unusedTrace,local=localMethods,mapped=mapped),
    admitted=list(null=mapply(identity,NULL),expression=mapply(typeof,expression(a,1+2)),call=mapply(typeof,quote(f(a=1,b=2))),
      emptyEnvironment=mapply(typeof,new.env()),symbolError=tryCatch(mapply(identity,quote(z)),error=conditionMessage)),
    fixed=list(list=Map(function(x,y=8)list(x,y),1:2,MoreArgs=list(y=4)),pairlist=Map(function(x,y=8)list(x,y),1:2,MoreArgs=pairlist(y=4)),null=mapply('+',1:2,3:4,MoreArgs=NULL)),
    formals=list(mapply=formals(mapply),Map=formals(Map)))
}

local({
  methods <- c('length.replicate_item', 'dim.replicate_item', 'dimnames.replicate_item',
               '==.replicate_control', 'as.integer.replicate_count', 'length.replicate_count')
  on.exit(rm(list = methods, envir = globalenv()))
  capture <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = conditionMessage,
                                    warning = function(w) paste('warning:', conditionMessage(w)))
  counts <- lapply(list(zero = 0L, fraction = 2.9, negative_fraction = -0.9,
                       character = '2', hexadecimal = '0x2', hex_float = '0x1p1',
                       hex_fraction = '0x1.8p1', hex_leading_dot = '0x.8p1',
                       hex_trailing_dot = '0x1.p1', hex_no_exponent = '0x1.8',
                       hex_negative_fraction = '-0x1p-1', zero_hex_overflow = '0x0p1024',
                       zero_hex_huge = '0x0p999999', negative_zero_hex = '-0x0p1024',
                       zero_hex_underflow = '0x0p-999999', zero_hex_fraction = '0x0.000p999999',
                       lower_inf = 'inf',
                       lower_infinity = 'infinity', lower_nan = 'nan', integer_na = NA_integer_,
                       double_na = NA_real_, character_na = NA_character_, nan = NaN,
                       infinity = Inf, negative = -1L, logical = TRUE, raw = as.raw(2),
                       complex = 2 + 1i, list = list(2L), vector = c(2L, 3L),
                       empty = integer(), null = NULL, invalid_text = 'bad',
                       factor = factor('b', levels = c('a', 'b'))),
                   function(n) capture(replicate(n, 11L)))
  missing <- list(n = capture(replicate(, 11L)), omitted_n = capture(replicate(expr = 11L)),
                  zero_expr = replicate(0,), omitted_zero_expr = replicate(0),
                  positive_expr = capture(replicate(1,)), omitted_positive_expr = capture(replicate(1)),
                  simplify = replicate(2, 11L, simplify = ))
  events <- character()
  ordered <- replicate({events <- c(events, 'n'); 2L},
                       {events <<- c(events, 'expr'); 1L},
                       simplify = {events <- c(events, 'simplify'); TRUE})
  order_events <- events
  events <- character()
  failed <- capture(replicate(2, {events <<- c(events, 'expr'); stop('expr')},
                              simplify = {events <- c(events, 'simplify'); stop('control')}))
  failed_events <- events
  events <- character()
  zero <- capture(replicate(0, stop('expr'), simplify = {events <- c(events, 'simplify'); stop('control')}))
  forcing <- list(value = ordered, events = order_events, failed = failed,
                  failed_events = failed_events, zero = zero, zero_events = events)
  x <- 0L
  ordinary <- replicate(3, {x <- x + 1L; x})
  ordinary_x <- x
  changed <- replicate(3, {x <<- x + 1L; x})
  fresh <- replicate(3, {present <- exists('scratch', inherits = FALSE); scratch <- 1L; present})
  caller <- environment()
  parents <- replicate(2, c(same = identical(environment(), caller),
                            parent = identical(parent.env(environment()), caller)))
  returned <- local({out <- replicate(2, {return(7L); stop('after')}); list(out, 'outer')})
  events <- character()
  exited <- replicate(2, {on.exit(events <<- c(events, 'exit')); events <<- c(events, 'expr'); 1L})
  exit_events <- events
  events <- character()
  exit_error <- capture(replicate(2, {on.exit(events <<- c(events, 'exit')); stop('expr')}))
  counter <- 0L
  closures <- replicate(3, {i <- counter; counter <<- counter + 1L; function() i}, FALSE)
  i <- 0L
  forward <- function(expr) replicate(3, expr)
  forwarded <- forward({i <- i + 1L; i})
  frames <- list(ordinary = ordinary, ordinary_caller = ordinary_x, changed = changed,
                 changed_caller = x, fresh = fresh, parents = parents, returned = returned,
                 exited = exited, exit_events = exit_events, exit_error = exit_error,
                 error_events = events, closures = lapply(closures, function(f) f()),
                 shared_frame = identical(environment(closures[[1]]), environment(closures[[2]])),
                 forwarded = forwarded, forwarded_caller = i,
                 dots = replicate(3, list(...)), dotdot = replicate(3, ..1))
  a <- matrix(1:4, 2, dimnames = list(rows = c('r1', 'r2'), cols = c('c1', 'c2')))
  controls <- lapply(list(false = FALSE, attributed_false = structure(FALSE, tag = 1L),
                         zero = 0, null = NULL, empty = logical(), missing = NA,
                         missing_text = NA_character_, list = list('array'),
                         symbol = quote(array), expression = expression(array),
                         multiple = c('array', 'array')),
                     function(control) list(scalar = capture(replicate(2, 1L, control)),
                                             array = capture(replicate(2, a, control))))
  shapes <- list(array = replicate(2, a), matrix = replicate(2, a, TRUE),
                 factor = replicate(2, factor('b', levels = c('a', 'b'))),
                 factor_vector = replicate(2, factor(c('a', 'b'))),
                 named = replicate(2, c(value = 1L)),
                 list = replicate(2, list(a = 1L, b = quote(z))),
                 null = replicate(2, NULL), empty = replicate(2, integer()))
  events <- character()
  length.replicate_item <<- function(x) {events <<- c(events, 'length'); 4L}
  dim.replicate_item <<- function(x) {events <<- c(events, 'dim'); c(2L, 2L)}
  dimnames.replicate_item <<- function(x) {events <<- c(events, 'dimnames'); list(c('r1', 'r2'), c('c1', 'c2'))}
  observed <- replicate(2, structure(1:4, class = 'replicate_item'))
  observed_events <- events
  `==.replicate_control` <<- function(e1, e2) {events <<- c(events, paste(.Generic, .Group, sep = ':')); TRUE}
  events <- character()
  controlled <- replicate(2, a, simplify = structure('other', class = 'replicate_control'))
  control_events <- events
  events <- character()
  scalar <- replicate(2, 1L, simplify = structure('other', class = 'replicate_control'))
  as.integer.replicate_count <<- function(x, ...) stop('count coercion method must remain unused')
  length.replicate_count <<- function(x) stop('count length method must remain unused')
  classed_count <- replicate(structure(2L, class = 'replicate_count'), 11L)
  method_results <- list(observed = observed, observed_events = observed_events,
                         controlled = controlled, control_events = control_events,
                         scalar = scalar, scalar_events = events, classed_count = classed_count)
  forced_values <- local({
    x <- 17L
    list(symbol = mapply(replicate, 2L, list(quote(x)), SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
         unbound = mapply(replicate, 2L, list(quote(no_such_object)), SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
         call = mapply(replicate, 2L, list(quote(1L + 2L)), SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
         syntax_symbol = do.call(replicate, list(2L, quote(x))),
         syntax_call = do.call(replicate, list(2L, quote(1L + 2L))))
  })
  visibility <- list(scalar = withVisible(replicate(2, invisible(1L))),
                     list = withVisible(replicate(2, invisible(1L), FALSE)),
                     zero = withVisible(replicate(0, 1L)))
  list(formals = formals(replicate), counts = counts, missing = missing,
       forcing = forcing, frames = frames, controls = controls, shapes = shapes,
       methods = method_results, forced_values = forced_values, visibility = visibility)
})

{
  inner <- list(
    suppressWarnings(tryCatch(warning("w", call. = FALSE), warning = identity)),
    suppressMessages(tryCatch(message("m"), message = identity)),
    suppressWarnings(tryCatch(log(-1), warning = identity)),
    tryCatch(sqrt(-1), warning = identity))
  cw <- warningCondition("custom", class = "fixture")
  filtered <- list(
    tryCatch(suppressWarnings(warning(cw), classes = "fixture"), warning = function(w) "escaped"),
    tryCatch(suppressWarnings(warning("plain", call. = FALSE), classes = "fixture"), warning = conditionMessage))
  startup <- list(
    tryCatch(packageStartupMessage("a", 1L), message = identity),
    tryCatch(packageStartupMessage("b", appendLF = FALSE), packageStartupMessage = identity),
    tryCatch(suppressPackageStartupMessages(packageStartupMessage("p")), message = function(m) "outer"),
    withVisible(suppressPackageStartupMessages(invisible(1))),
    withVisible(suppressMessages(invisible(2))),
    withVisible(suppressWarnings(3)))
  list(inner = inner, filtered = filtered, startup = startup)
}

{
  trace <- character()
  resumed <- withCallingHandlers(
    withCallingHandlers({ warning("w1", call. = FALSE); trace <- c(trace, "after"); 10L },
      warning = function(w) trace <<- c(trace, paste("inner", conditionMessage(w)))),
    warning = function(w) { trace <<- c(trace, "outer"); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  messageOrder <- character()
  muffled <- withCallingHandlers(message("m"),
    message = function(m) messageOrder <<- c(messageOrder, "message"),
    condition = function(c) { messageOrder <<- c(messageOrder, "condition"); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") })
  restartNames <- NULL
  warned <- withCallingHandlers(warning("w2", call. = FALSE), warning = function(w) {
    restartNames <<- vapply(computeRestarts(w), function(r) unclass(r)[[1L]], "")
    invokeRestart(computeRestarts(w)[[1L]]) })
  recovered <- withRestarts(
    withCallingHandlers(stop("boom", call. = FALSE),
      error = function(e) invokeRestart("recover", conditionMessage(e), 2L)),
    recover = function(msg, code) list(message = msg, code = code))
  nested <- withRestarts(
    withRestarts(vapply(computeRestarts(), function(r) unclass(r)[[1L]], ""), inner = function() 1),
    outer = function() 2)
  unwound <- character()
  transferred <- withRestarts({
    f <- function() { on.exit(unwound <<- c(unwound, "on.exit")); invokeRestart("leave", 5L); "unreached" }
    f()
  }, leave = function(v) { unwound <<- c(unwound, "restart"); v * 2L })
  list(resumed = resumed, trace = trace, muffled = muffled, messageOrder = messageOrder,
    warned = warned, restartNames = restartNames, recovered = recovered, nested = nested,
    transferred = transferred, unwound = unwound)
}
